During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] constructed a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamsis Callo]] under a [[Schenor/Imperial treaty|treaty]] they signed with the native [[Schenor]] government.<ref name="Silent" />
